hypothesis: A one-call condition evidence ledger preserves the achieved-versus-missing semantic evidence that the three aggregate v4 scores discard, improving partial F1 without tree routing or a second model call.

rubric_change.condition_ledger: List at most four atomic requested semantic conditions and mark each as absent, emerging, mostly, or complete.
rubric_change.achieved_evidence: Name the strongest visibly achieved requested condition.
rubric_change.missing_evidence: Name the most important absent, wrong, residual, or incomplete requested condition.
rubric_change.semantic_completion: One integer 0..100 derived from condition status and requested scope; standalone visual quality cannot lower it.
rubric_change.calibration_feature: semantic_completion, forced to zero for replaced scenes

evidence_basis.selection_data: The prompt categories were derived from v4 errors on all 392 EditInspector calibration cases and aggregate collision statistics on 600 ImagenHub cases.
evidence_basis.consequence: Neither the 80-case development slice nor the former 312-case confirmation slice is independent for v6. They are prompt-development diagnostics only.
evidence_basis.clean_confirmation: The untouched 391-case EditInspector final partition remains the only clean in-domain confirmation.

stage_1_prompt_smoke.purpose: Check schema reliability, score dispersion, and whether the candidate is promising enough to spend on clean confirmation.
stage_1_prompt_smoke.baseline: Existing gpt-4.1-mini v4 outputs on the exact same 80 cases.
stage_1_prompt_smoke.metrics: Five-fold task-grouped OOF cutpoint metrics; descriptive because prompt design used these labels.

stage_2_clean_confirmation.execution: Run paired v4 and v6 judgments without fitting or inspecting final labels until both checkpoints are complete.

stage_3_cross_dataset.partition: A task-disjoint ImagenHub partition not used to design or select v6.
stage_3_cross_dataset.gate: The same partial-F1, balanced-accuracy, and accuracy deltas as stage 2.

stopping_rule: Stop immediately after any failed stage. Do not add routing, feature rules, or another verifier to rescue the prompt.
